Refactor a reference hydrofabric (split, collapse, reconcile; refactor phase)

Source: R/refactor_reference.R
refactor_fabric.Rd

Consumes a reference fabric + FDR/FAC rasters; produces refactored flowpaths, reconciled flowpaths + divides (raster-partitioned), and a COMID->reconciled_id lineage table. This is the raster-heavy stage; aggregate phase has no raster dependency.

Usage

refactor_fabric(
  vpuid,
  reference_gpkg,
  fdr_path,
  fac_path,
  fallback_fdr_path = NULL,
  fallback_fac_path = NULL,
  hydrolocations_gpkg = NULL,
  exclude_hl_types = NULL,
  out_dir,
  tolerance_m = 500,
  snap_threshold_m = 250,
  split_flines_meters = 1e+09,
  collapse_flines_meters = 250,
  force_lr = TRUE,
  n_cores = NULL,
  use_checkpoints = FALSE
)

Arguments

vpuid

VPU identifier (e.g. "01", "21").

reference_gpkg

Path to the reference fabric. May be multi-VPU (auto-sliced) or a single-VPU fabric.

fdr_path

Path (or /vsis3/...) to the D8 flow-direction raster.

fac_path

Path (or /vsis3/...) to the flow-accumulation raster.

fallback_fdr_path, fallback_fac_path

Optional paths to fallback FDR / FAC rasters used when the primary rasters return NoData. NULL disables the fallback (default); ignored when equal to the primary paths.

hydrolocations_gpkg

Optional path to a separate hydrolocations GeoPackage (POIs to embed). When NULL, hydrolocations are read from reference_gpkg if present.

exclude_hl_types

Hydrolocation hl_type values dropped at ingest; see run_pipeline().

out_dir

Parent output directory; vpu_{vpuid}/ is created.

tolerance_m

POI snap tolerance (m), used in generate_events.

snap_threshold_m

Warn when a POI snap distance exceeds this (m).

split_flines_meters

Split flowlines longer than this (m); the default (1e9) effectively disables Stage-1 splitting (routing-unit splitting is done later by add_flowlines()).

collapse_flines_meters

Minimum inter-confluence segment length (m).

force_lr

Force left/right event assignment.

n_cores

Worker count for reconcile_divides.

use_checkpoints

Logical; if TRUE, reuse existing stage-1 checkpoints instead of recomputing.

Value

Invisibly, a list with files (named character, output paths), timings (named list of elapsed seconds), invariants (named list).

Details

Writes to {out_dir}/vpu_{vpuid}/work/:

  • refactored.gpkg (single layer: flowpaths)

  • reconciled.gpkg (layers: flowpaths, divides, events)

  • pois.gpkg (event-bearing POIs, deduplicated)

  • hydrolocations.gpkg (copy of the reference layer for the nextgen phase)

  • lineage.parquet (COMID -> reconciled_id, list cols coerced to CSV)

  • timings.json, invariants.json

  • provenance.json (written by the caller: refactor_fabric() only returns the record; writing happens once the caller knows the image digest + upstream ids).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
refactor_fabric(vpuid          = "01",
                reference_gpkg = "reference_01.gpkg",
                fdr_path       = "fdr.tif",
                fac_path       = "fac.tif",
                out_dir        = "out",
                collapse_flines_meters = 300)
} # }
